events.title: The Maneki Mania demo is out now
events.summary: The Maneki Mania demo is out now The free demo of Maneki Mania is available right now on Steam for Windows, Mac and Linux. Hit Download Demo on the store page and start petting the lucky cat. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/46213152/480de8a9cbc51923797d7958da474dd09227b0e3.jpg Why a week early? Steam Next Fest starts on October 19. We are putting the demo out a week before so you can play it calmly, without the festival rush, and tell us what you think. Every comment helps us polish the game before Next Fest

events.title: Maneki Mania now runs on Mac, Linux and Steam Deck
events.summary: Good news for the cat. Maneki Mania runs natively on macOS and Linux now, and it's Steam Deck ready. Wherever you sit down to play, your lucky cat is ready to wave the coins in. The free demo lands on October 19. No cost, no catch. Give it a spin on Windows, Mac, Linux or your Deck before you buy. Wishlist Maneki Mania and Steam will ping you the moment the demo goes live: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4931850/
